svg.title: MedMNIST Neural Architecture Search Framework
svg.desc: A publication-ready framework diagram showing three parallel NAS pipelines for PathMNIST, ChestMNIST, and DermaMNIST datasets, each producing an optimized disease classification model.
svg.text: MedMNIST-NAS: automated architecture discovery for medical image classification
Pareto-optimal selection: accuracy vs. efficiency trade-off
Best architecture per task retained; cross-task ensemble optional
